notes.title: Update Note: 20/12/24
notes.content: Achievements were not triggering - this has been rectified, and you should now be able to trigger and collect the achievements.

notes.title: Secrets In Green Out NOW!
notes.content:
It's time to smash the patriarchy!!

Borealis here, so excited to let you know that Secrets In Green is now available to purchase!  What's more, its already reasonable price has been slashed further, with a 15% launch discount for you to enjoy!  Tis the season, so why not gift yourself this spellbinding tale of female empowerment, and maybe snag it for your buddies too?  The discount only lasts a week, so get on it while you can!

If you're on the fence about buying the game, or have any questions, don't forget to check out the FAQ thread in the discussions - I've added plenty of info there that should help you make your decision.

So, are you ready to help Alma find her power and solve the strange mystery unfolding within her garden?  Are the plants really talking to her, or is there something even more sinister afoot?  It's up to you to find out!

Enjoy!
Borealis

notes.title: Release Date Confirmed!
notes.content:
Yo, gamers!  Borealis here with some awesome news!

Steam has officially finished turning its contemplative cogs about our powerful feminist story, and I'm thrilled to announce...  ahem...

Secrets In Green will release via Steam on Dec 19th, with a week-long 15% launch discount!

Huzzah!  Get it on your wishlists and spread the word - your festive season is about to get a whole lot more mysterious, entertaining AND empowering  💪

Roll on the 19th!
Borealis

notes.title: Secrets In Green Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello Steam buddies, and welcome to Secrets In Green!

Developer Borealis here, and I'm super happy to be releasing my third game.  This one has quite a different setting from my previous ones - this time, we're going back to Victorian England to explore the struggle that women went through during such a tough period of male-centric society.

You guys know I always like to slip some kind of important theme or message into my games, and as a non-binary female, this one is a recurring theme in my life.  Therefore, I crafted Secrets In Green to show support, encouragement and solidarity for women and other gender/sex marginalised people 💜

Something I also wanna clarify is that while this game is marked as a horror, it's much less so than True Colours.  For anyone who's a little worried about dark/disturbing content, Secrets In Green is relatively safe in comparison.

So then!  I'll be dropping our official release date very soon, but for now, feel free to pop this intriguing mystery on your wishlist and spread the word to all your mates!

More updates soon!
Borealis
